title: Run repository code and tests in the sandbox
what: Implemented: the container has open internet, Pi read/write/edit/bash run in it, and GitHub credentials are added only by GitHubEgress. Left: confirm on the deployed Worker that the daemon installs, TLS interception works for git and gh, and a clone, test run and push succeed; then remove the github_* tools that git and gh now replace.

acceptance.text: The agent can check out a repository at a ref in its sandbox and run its tests
Network access is limited to an allowlist and no credential is visible inside the container
